body:
What is the output of `STARSHIP_LOG='debug' starship module directory` for RDP/SSH? Is your VNC shell a login shell, could something in your `.bash_profile` be interfering?
In general, you can replace the config file in use with the `STARSHIP_CONFIG` environment variable.

Thanks a bunch. I could figure it out thanks to you.

---

swlp-main/packages/swlp-frontend

We can see that via SSH `STARSHIP_CONFIG` is not set, but via RDP it is and with a non default path.
I searched my dotfiles git repo and found a file I created 2 years ago which sets `STARSHIP_CONFIG` to store the config file in its own directory. This file is run via `.profile` as an `sh` script. And as it seems `.profile` is not run via SSH. My knowledge is too lacking to come up with a reason why.

The solution I came up with is moving the `STARSHIP_CONFIG` assignment into `.bashrc` right before starship is initialized.
